text:
This book does not exist.

Pages that would inhabit

the void absurdly. I remember

—the association is not evident—

the crazed bird

flying, flying again over the sea

unable or not knowing how to alight,

it turned in the void,

flew within itself

Are words life or do they go against life?




1974

translation.title: The Book
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the bird image and the book's self-canceling question.
